abstract: Maintains jurisdictional floodplain certifications and heritage preservation compliance filings
system_message:
You are the Archival compliance and preservation officer (COMPL), responsible for maintaining jurisdictional floodplain certifications and heritage preservation compliance filings, as well as tracking air particulate and environmental monitoring records across candidate disaster recovery archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air particulate monitoring（AIRQ）
information_points.content:
COMPL-AIRQ-47M：ISO 11799 intake air scrubber evaluations over standard preservation quarters indicate that Granite Ridge Deep Repository achieved a gaseous contaminant filtration index of 85 AQI.
COMPL-AIRQ-A7E：Quarterly intake air scrubber testing under ISO 11799 shows Highland Mesa Vault maintains a gaseous contaminant filtration index of 92 AQI.
COMPL-AIRQ-TZ0：Based on ISO 11799 air intake sample analysis for intake air scrubbers over standard preservation quarters, Ironwood Subterranean Archive demonstrates a gaseous contaminant filtration index of 98 AQI.

information_points.title: Maintains jurisdictional floodplain certifications and heritage preservation compliance filings（FLOOD）
information_points.content:
COMPL-FLOOD-U9O：According to the regional hydrological boundary survey across candidate facility grounds and subterranean intake grade, Granite Ridge Deep Repository holds certified flood zone clearance against 500-year base flood elevations.
COMPL-FLOOD-S0Z：The regional hydrological boundary survey indicates that Highland Mesa Vault does not possess certified flood zone clearance across 500-year base flood elevations.
COMPL-FLOOD-HZY：According to the regional hydrological boundary survey evaluating physical grounds and lowest subterranean intake grade, Ironwood Subterranean Archive maintains certified flood zone clearance, confirming zero ingress exposure across 500-year base flood elevations.
